title: When the Terminal Turns Again
author: Emrys Yarrow
blurb: Orsen Dravenmoor, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
